obligor_name: Watsonville Community Hospital / Pajaro Valley Health Care District
_notes: Two-phase entity. Halsen Healthcare filed Ch 11 Dec 2021 (predecessor). Pajaro Valley Health Care District (newly formed public district) acquired hospital out of bankruptcy Sep 2022 ($65M). Measure N $116M bond passed Mar 2024 (>68.6% yes) → district bought buildings + 27 acres for $40M from Medical Properties Trust (Oct 2024). Watsonville is now a public-district-owned hospital. No public agency rating on the new GO bond identified within budget.

moodys.citation_text: PVHCD newly formed public entity acquired hospital out of Halsen Ch 11 Sep 2022. No legacy bond obligor structure carried.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Measure N $116M GO bond passed 68.6% Mar 5 2024 (66.67% threshold).
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Watsonville hospital bond adopted by voters; bond measure approved with more than 68.6% of the vote.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: PVHCD acquired hospital buildings + 27 acres from Medical Properties Trust for $40M.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Watsonville Community Hospital returns to public ownership; the district officially acquired the hospital buildings and the 27 acres of land they sit on for $40 million from Alabama-based Medical Properties Trust.

moodys.citation_text: Rating on Measure N bond issuance not identified within budget.

outcome_class_rationale: Predecessor Halsen Healthcare defaulted Dec 2021 (pre-window). PVHCD new public-district successor acquired hospital Sep 2022 (entering window). Voters approved $116M GO Mar 2024, district closed asset purchase Oct 2024. Functioning ongoing concern post-reorg through window. Distress is a pre-window event for this obligor entity; in-window activity is reorg execution, not deterioration.
